## GraphBuilder.relation() method

A relation `from › to:name`<!-- -->: its strategies project loaders' values into links, combined as  `fallback` or `union`<!-- -->, optionally verified, held to its cardinality and its caps.

**Signature:**

```typescript
relation<F extends keyof E & string, T extends keyof E & string, const Name extends string, L extends Attrs = Empty>(from: F, to: T, name: Name, spec: {
        readonly cardinality: Cardinality;
        readonly link?: Schema<L>;
        readonly combine?: "fallback" | "union";
        readonly strategies: (s: StrategyMaker<E, F, T, L>) => readonly [Strategy<F, T>, ...Strategy<F, T>[]];
        readonly verify?: (v: VerifyMaker<E, T, L>) => VerificationDef;
        readonly caps?: {
            readonly links?: number;
        };
    }): Relation<F, T, `${F} › ${T}:${Name}`, L>;
```
